edits.text:
- cmd: V2_HOST_BOOT
      number_of_values: 16
      type: CMD_READ_ONLY
      help: Validated host bootstrap record, including array and session cookie.
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      hidden: false
    - cmd: V2_HOST_CLOCK
      number_of_values: 8
      type: CMD_READ_ONLY
      help: I2S frame count and RTOS ticks, little endian uint32 each. Not a clock frequency measurement.
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      hidden: false
    - cmd: MIC_MUTE
      index: 11
      number_of_values: 1
      type: CMD_READ_WRITE
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      value_ranges:
          value0: [0 .. 1]
      help: Software zero of processed microphone output; clocks and raw diagnostics remain active.
      hidden: false
    - cmd: MIC_RAW_LEVELS
      index: 13
      number_of_values: 4
      type: CMD_READ_ONLY
      value_type: TYPE_FLOAT
      help: Full-frame RMS for physical D0 through D3 before in-place AEC processing.
      hidden: false
    - cmd: UI_STATE
      index: 14
      number_of_values: 1
      type: CMD_READ_WRITE
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      value_ranges:
          value0: [0 .. 14]
      help: Voice DSP UI state; zero returns to DOA. Probe V2_UI_CAPS before use.
      hidden: false
    - cmd: UI_PROGRESS
      index: 15
      number_of_values: 1
      type: CMD_READ_WRITE
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      value_ranges:
          value0: [0 .. 100]
      help: UI progress percentage; no firmware updater is implemented.
      hidden: false
    - cmd: V2_UI_CAPS
      index: 16
      number_of_values: 8
      type: CMD_READ_ONLY
      value_type: TYPE_UINT8
      help: Fixed V2UI revision 1 flags 15 LED count 24 reserved 0; not firmware-version negotiation.
      hidden: false
